messages:
lina: Quick sync — we need to distill the benchmark + webinar launch hooks into a tiny battlecard. Goal: 1-pager + 3 soundbites for SDRs and a 90s webinar blurb. Who's in?
omar: I'm in. I have the raw latency/cost numbers from the bench open.
tess: Also please prioritize fallback/availability messaging vs infra vendors — customers keep asking ‘what if a region goes down?’
beau: Can we make a razor econ line: "Redwood saves X% per 1M tokens vs managed endpoints" — need the exact calc to back it.
sangita: @omar can you drop the spreadsheet link here? :point_down: Also include a short line about Private + KMS for regulated buyers.
omar: Pasted spreadsheet (internal): https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/q1-llm-econ. Highlights: avg token latency 35ms (hosted) vs ~70ms observed on a couple managed endpoints for same model; cost delta ~32% at 1M tokens when you account for batching+caching.
maria: Draft hook ideas (very short):
- Predictable cost. Predictable latency.
- Ship LLM features without owning the stack.
- Keep apps online with automatic variant fallback.
ev an: For SDRs: 1) one crisp latency+cost stat, 2) one sentence about canary/rollback, 3) private + KMS mention.
tess: Objection handlers (short):
- "Why not just use cloud managed endpoints?" -> "Same API surface, but deterministic SLOs, reserved capacity, and cost controls (smart batching + quantization)."
- "Can you guarantee quality after quantization?" -> "We tie regressions to your eval prompts and alert before rollout."
beau: Need a short line about evals/regression alerts: "Automatic quality monitors tied to your prompts prevent silent regressions."
lina: Love it. Can we compress into 3 bullets + 2 soundbites + a 90s webinar blurb?
omar: 90s webinar blurb draft: "See how Redwood cut per-token spend 30% while keeping 99.95% tail latency under 120ms for a 10k RPS production workload. Live demo + practical tips on batching, quantization, and rollout strategy."
sangita: Quick inbound routing rules snippet (for ops playbook):
```
if company.size > 2000 and security_requirement == 'private':
  route -> enterprise_sales
elif company.industry == 'regulated':
  route -> solutions_eng
else:
  route -> self_serve_sdr
```
maria: Maybe hide the code example on the one-pager and put it in an appendix for AE/SE. Keep the customer-facing copy non-technical.
ev an: A/B test idea for webinar CTA: "Predictable cost & latency" vs "Stop guessing your token bills" — run on signup variant for 48 hours.
tess: Proposed timeline: finalize soundbites by Tue EOD, craft one-pager Wed, SDR training Thurs morning, webinar dry-run Fri.
lina: Assigning: @omar bench numbers, @maria draft the one-pager, @beau produce the econ claim + backup calc, @tess produce objection card + rebut scripts, @evan set up A/B test. I’ll own the webinar blurb + slides.
omar: Ack. I’ll add the calc tab to the sheet.
beau: I’ll drop the full cost worked example and a one-line backup in the sheet.
maria: Will draft v1 one-pager and ping for review here.
tess: I’ll produce the objection play card and 3 short rebut scripts for SDRs.
lina: Cool — 15-min sync Thurs 10am to review. Thanks everyone :rocket:
